column1: # What build/check-upstream.sh watches, and the single source of truth for it.
# The script (shared verbatim with the two binding repositories) knows how to query each
# ecosystem but nothing about which components matter here. This repository binds nothing, so
# what it watches is the two NATIVE SDK lines its pinned binding packages wrap: a new Salesforce
# release is the signal that the binding repositories will move and this façade will need
# re-pinning behind them. The binding packages themselves are pinned by hand in
# Directory.Build.props and have no automated watcher - they are this author's own releases.
#   group    reporting group - one note file per group, titled with this text
#   label    how the component is named inside the note
#   pin      the MSBuild property in Directory.Build.props holding the pinned version
#   locator  kind-specific: pod name, groupId:artifactId[:packaging][@repo], or owner/repo
#   confirm  download URL template with {version}, or "-" to derive it from the locator
